stories.headline: Apple debuts M6, its first 2nm chip, and the quad-die M5 Ultra, with price hikes on Mac mini and Studio

key_facts.fact: Apple on Aug 25 debuted M6 in a new Mac mini and M5 Ultra in a new Mac Studio; M6 is Apple's first 2-nanometer chip, with a 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, a Dual 16-core Neural Engine and up to 170GB/s of unified memory bandwidth.
key_facts.excerpt: M6, Apple's first state-of-the-art 2-nanometer chip, advances every compute block... a larger 12-core CPU complex with the world's fastest CPU core, a larger 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and up to 170GB/s of unified memory bandwidth.

key_facts.fact: M5 Ultra uses UltraFusion to connect two dual-die M5 Max chips into Apple's first quad-die SoC, with over 4.4TB/s of inter-die bandwidth, up to a 36-core CPU and an 80-core GPU.
key_facts.excerpt: M5 Ultra uses UltraFusion to connect two dual-die M5 Max chips to form the quad-die architecture — a first for Apple silicon. UltraFusion increases the inter-die bandwidth to over 4.4TB/s and the connection density by over 6x.

key_facts.fact: Mac Studio with M5 Ultra supports up to 512GB of unified memory and 1.2TB/s of memory bandwidth, 50% more than M3 Ultra, letting users run LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device.
key_facts.excerpt: M5 Ultra features a massive amount of high-bandwidth unified memory, up to 512GB, and delivers a staggering 1.2TB/s of unified memory bandwidth that is 50 percent higher than M3 Ultra... run huge LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device.

key_facts.fact: M5 Ultra's 80-core GPU includes a Neural Accelerator in each core, giving up to 4.5x the peak GPU compute for AI compared with M3 Ultra.
key_facts.excerpt: M5 Ultra features a next-generation GPU with up to 80 cores, incorporating a Neural Accelerator in each core to offer up to 4.5x the peak GPU compute for AI compared to M3 Ultra.

key_facts.fact: Prices rose: the M6 Mac mini starts at $899 and the M5 Pro Mac mini at $1,699, each $100 above the M4 models, while the M5 Ultra Mac Studio starts at $5,499, up $200.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple raises Mac mini and Studio prices: the M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini are $899+ and $1,699+, $100 above M4 models, and the M5 Ultra Mac Studio is $5,499+, up $200 (Nicole Nguyen/Wall Street Journal)

key_facts.fact: The new Mac mini models are available for preorder now and ship after September 22.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple's newest Mac Mini devices are available for preorder now, starting at $899. They will ship after September 22.

stories.headline: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip beats Nvidia Blackwell on performance per watt in first public benchmarks

key_facts.fact: OpenAI presented its custom inference chip Jalapeño at Hot Chips and let SemiAnalysis benchmark it; the chip, built with Broadcom, went from team hiring to tape-out in about 16 months.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI has spent the past couple years quietly building 'Jalapeño,' an inference chip just announced at Hot Chips... Design work began in the middle of 2024, going from initial team hiring to manufacturing tape-out in ~16 months, an extremely fast ASIC development cycle.

key_facts.fact: Jalapeño delivered 1.5x to 1.9x more AI work per watt and 1.7x to 3.6x lower latency than Nvidia's Blackwell chips across tests on GPT-OSS, DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K2.5.
key_facts.excerpt: Jalapeño outperformed Blackwell in many scenarios, delivering 1.5 to 1.9 times more AI work per watt and 1.7 to 3.6 times lower latency, especially excelling in both low-latency and high-throughput scenarios.

key_facts.fact: In testing, Jalapeño hit over 700 tokens per second per user at concurrency 1 on DeepSeek R1 and roughly 1,400 tokens/sec/user on GPT-OSS, without speculative decoding or prefill-decode disaggregation.
key_facts.excerpt: At low concurrency scenarios, Jalapeño demonstrates remarkable interactivity, hitting over 700 tokens per sec per user at concurrency 1 on the DeepSeek R1 model... GPT-OSS which ran at approximately 1,400 tok/sec/user... all achieved with single-token prediction (STP), no speculative decoding and no prefill-decode disaggregation.

key_facts.fact: The tested A0 silicon is already succeeded by a B0 stepping in the fab that delivers roughly 25% better performance per watt and 13.4 PFLOPs of MXFP4 on a reticle-sized TSMC N3P compute die, versus 17.5 PFLOPs for a comparable Nvidia Rubin die.
key_facts.excerpt: B0 has optimizations that deliver roughly a 25% perf-per-watt improvement over the earlier A0 silicon. Specifically, the B0 stepping delivers 13.4 PFLOPs of MXFP4 on a single reticle-sized compute die that is manufactured on TSMC's N3P. This compares to 17.5 PFLOPs of dense Rubin NVFP4 for a single Rubin compute die.

key_facts.fact: Jalapeño ships with HBM4, giving 15.4TB/s of memory bandwidth per package, and runs at a 700W TDP versus 900-1,150W for a Rubin compute die.
key_facts.excerpt: Jalapeño will ship with HBM4... This results in 15.4TB/s of memory bandwidth per package which bests all the other accelerators shipping that are using HBM3E... Jalapeño's TDP is only 700W compared to Rubin's at 900-1,150W per compute die.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI and Broadcom first unveiled Jalapeño in June 2026 as an accelerator built from scratch for LLM inference, to be deployed at gigawatt scale with data center partners.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI on Wednesday announced its first custom chip developed with Broadcom. Called Jalapeño and designed by OpenAI, the chip, the companies said, provides better performance per watt than current state-of-the-art chips in early testing.

stories.headline: Nvidia puts Groq 3 LPX inference accelerator into full production, with Nebius as first cloud customer

key_facts.fact: Nvidia announced at Hot Chips on Aug 24 that Groq 3 LPX, an interactive AI inference accelerator extending the Vera Rubin platform, is now in full production.
key_facts.excerpt: Hot Chips—NVIDIA today announced that NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX, the interactive AI inference accelerator, is now in full production. An extension of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, Groq 3 LPX delivers a major boost in AI inference by enabling ultrafast token generation for highly responsive agentic systems.

key_facts.fact: In Artificial Analysis benchmarking, Groq 3 LPX ran Gemma 4 31B at a record 3,400 output tokens per second with a 100,000-token context — the fastest ever recorded for that model.
key_facts.excerpt: It delivered a record 3,400 output tokens per second in Artificial Analysis benchmarking running Gemma 4 31B, an open source agentic model, with a 100,000-token context critical for agentic systems — the fastest performance ever recorded for the model.

key_facts.fact: Each LPX rack couples 256 LPU accelerators with 128GB of on-chip SRAM and 640TB/s of scale-up bandwidth, fully liquid-cooled on the Nvidia MGX rack architecture; each LPU has 500MB of SRAM and 150TB/s of SRAM bandwidth.
key_facts.excerpt: Each NVIDIA LPX rack couples 256 LPU accelerators with 128 GB of on-chip SRAM and 640 TB/s of scale-up bandwidth, fully liquid-cooled using the NVIDIA MGX rack architecture.

key_facts.fact: Nebius is the first AI cloud to adopt Groq 3 LPX, bringing it to its Nebius Token Factory inference platform.
key_facts.excerpt: Nebius, a leading AI cloud, plans to bring NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX to Nebius Token Factory, its production inference platform, giving developers access to extreme token generation speed for highly responsive agentic AI applications.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia projects that Vera Rubin NVL72 with LPX delivers up to 35x higher inference throughput per megawatt for 2-trillion-parameter models at long context and low latency than GB200 NVL72.
key_facts.excerpt: With NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA projects up to 35x higher inference throughput per megawatt for 2T-parameter models at long-context and low-latency than GB200 NVL72.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia also said SpaceXAI is deploying its Vera CPU for agentic AI at massive scale, and Elon Musk said SpaceX and Nvidia designed a space-optimized Vera Rubin NVL72 system for launch to orbit in Q4 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Elon Musk /@elonmusk: SpaceX, in partnership with Nvidia, has designed a space-optimized Vera Rubin NVL72 system for launch to orbit in Q4 next year, with significant scale in 2028... @nvidianewsroom: The first CPU built for agents is now at work at massive scale. @SpaceXAI is deploying NVIDIA Vera to power agentic AI.

stories.headline: Unitree shares slump 45% after fivefold IPO pop, wiping $30B off the robot maker's value

key_facts.fact: Unitree shares have fallen roughly 45% since their Shanghai debut, steadying on Tuesday Aug 25 after three straight days of decline.
key_facts.excerpt: Unitree shares steadied today after three consecutive days of decline that took their losses to 45% since their debut last Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: The company's valuation soared to $66 billion at one point and later plunged by $30 billion, raising questions about whether AI and robotics enthusiasm has outpaced fundamentals.
key_facts.excerpt: The wild swings in Unitree's valuation - soaring to $66 billion at one point and later plunging by $30 billion - have led to questions about whether enthusiasm for AI and robotics has outpaced fundamentals.

key_facts.fact: Unitree closed up 460% on its Aug 19 debut, against an average first-day gain of 226% for new Chinese listings over the past three years.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Unitree, which competes with Tesla and Hyundai Motor Group-owned Boston Dynamics, finished up 460 per cent on its debut. That compares with an average first-day gain of 226 per cent for newly listed stocks in China over the past three years.

key_facts.fact: Analysts blamed China's listing mechanism and the absence of short-sellers; asset manager Dong Baozhen said investors 'were carried away by the technology revolution narrative' and that 'all bubbles are doomed to burst.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Investors were carried away by the technology revolution narrative,' said Dong Baozhen, chairman of Beijing-based asset manager Lingtong Shengtai, cautioning that 'all bubbles are doomed to burst.'

key_facts.fact: Unitree's first-half 2026 profit showed signs of a downshift and the company has had little success in broader commercial applications despite viral running, dancing and martial-arts robot demos.
key_facts.excerpt: The blockbuster debut came even as Unitree's first-half profit showed signs of a downshift. The company's robots have drawn attention for running, dancing and performing martial arts, but Unitree has had little success in broader commercial applications.

key_facts.fact: Unitree priced its IPO at 150.80 yuan a share and raised about 6.1 billion yuan ($905 million); DeepSeek invested about 140.8 million yuan and Tencent is an existing shareholder.
key_facts.excerpt: The Hangzhou-based robot maker... raised about 6.1 billion yuan ($905 million) in its IPO, according to its prospectus. The IPO also drew backing from Chinese AI company DeepSeek, which invested about 140.8 million yuan, according to a company filing. Unitree's existing investors also include Chinese tech giant Tencent.

stories.headline: Nvidia-backed neocloud Lambda in talks to raise $3B at a $12B-plus valuation, teeing up an IPO

key_facts.fact: Lambda, an Nvidia-backed AI cloud provider, is in talks to raise as much as $3 billion in a round that could set up a public listing as soon as next year.
key_facts.excerpt: Lambda Inc., an AI cloud-computing provider backed by Nvidia Corp., is in talks to raise as much as $3 billion in a round that could tee it up to go public next year, according to people familiar with the efforts.

key_facts.fact: The company has discussed raising the money at a valuation of as much as $12 billion or more; terms are not final and talks are ongoing.
key_facts.excerpt: The company... has discussed raising the money at a valuation of as much as $12 billion or more, the people said... The fundraising talks are ongoing and deal terms haven't been finalized.

key_facts.fact: Lambda is expected to earn more than $1.5 billion in revenue this year and has already received multiple term sheets for the round.
key_facts.excerpt: Lambda has already received multiple term sheets for the round. The company is expected to earn more than $1.5 billion in revenue this year, some of the people said.

key_facts.fact: The raise would come roughly nine months after Lambda's $1.5 billion-plus Series E led by TWG Global in November 2025, which valued it near $5.9 billion; a February 2025 Series D had valued it at about $2.5 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Lambda's own most recent raise came in November 2025: more than $1.5 billion led by TWG Global... That followed a $480 million Series D in February 2025, which valued the company at roughly $2.5 billion at the time.

key_facts.fact: Other Lambda backers include ARK Invest, OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy, Scott Hassan's family office SGW and Andra Capital; the round lands as rival neoclouds CoreWeave, Crusoe and Nscale chase similar raises or listings.
key_facts.excerpt: Andra Capital, Scott Hassan's family office SGW, OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy, Cathie Wood's ARK Invest, and Nvidia among the other backers... as rival neoclouds CoreWeave, Crusoe, and Nscale all chase similarly large raises or listings.

stories.headline: Emerald AI raises $150M at a $1.05B valuation to make data centers flex their power draw

key_facts.fact: Emerald AI announced on Aug 25 a $150 million Series A at a $1.05 billion valuation, co-led by DCVC and Energize Capital.
key_facts.excerpt: Emerald AI, a Washington, DC-based provider of a platform turning data centers into flexible assets for the power grid, raised $150M in Series A funding, at $1.05B valuation. The round was co-led by Energize Capital and DCVC.

key_facts.fact: Investors in the round include Nvidia, Samsung Ventures, Siemens, GE Vernova, Salesforce Ventures, Aramco Ventures, RWE, In-Q-Tel, Radical Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, John Doerr and Tom Steyer.
key_facts.excerpt: with participation from NVIDIA, Samsung Ventures, Siemens, Aramco Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, GE Vernova, RWE, JERA Ventures... In-Q-Tel, Radical Ventures, Energy Impact Partners, Lowercarbon Capital... John Doerr, Tom Steyer.

key_facts.fact: Its Emerald Conductor platform orchestrates AI workloads and onsite energy to cut a facility's power draw during grid stress; the company says the approach could unlock up to 100 gigawatts of capacity on the existing US grid.
key_facts.excerpt: transforming AI data centers into flexible grid assets that dynamically adjust power consumption in response to power grid conditions, an approach that can unlock up to 100 gigawatts of capacity on the existing U.S. grid for AI while protecting grid reliability and energy affordability for communities.

key_facts.fact: Emerald AI has contracts in California and Virginia and is running tests with Nvidia and Oracle; founder and CEO Varun Sivaram pitches it as a fix for regional backlash against data center construction.
key_facts.excerpt: Emerald AI has secured contracts in California and Virginia and is testing with Nvidia and Oracle. Founder Sivalram aims to transform data centres from grid burdens into flexible resources, addressing regional backlash against data centre construction.

key_facts.fact: The raise follows a UK demonstration with National Grid in which Emerald managed 96 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPUs at a Nebius data center in London and cut power demand by up to 40% across more than 200 simulated grid events without disrupting workloads.
key_facts.excerpt: Emerald AI utilize its Emerald Conductor platform to manage a cluster of 96 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPUs at a Nebius data center in London... It simulated more than 200 real-time 'grid events'... cutting power demand by up to 40 percent without impacting critical workloads.

key_facts.excerpt: Generalist has quietly raised around $200 million in new funding, just two months after the robotics AI startup raised $400 million.

key_facts.fact: 8VC led the round, joined by several existing investors; the valuation is above the $2 billion mark set in June.
key_facts.excerpt: 8VC led the new round, per a source, and was joined by several other existing investors. No specific info on valuation, except that it's above the $2 billion mark from June.

key_facts.fact: Generalist builds AI models rather than robot hardware, and was founded by alumni of Google DeepMind and Boston Dynamics; backers include Nvidia, Bezos Expeditions, Radical Ventures, USV, Spark Capital and Fei-Fei Li.
key_facts.excerpt: Generalist, which builds models rather than robotic hardware, was founded by alumni of Google DeepMind and Boston Dynamics. Backers include Nvidia, Bezos Expeditions, Radical Ventures, USV, Hanabi, Spark Capital, and Fei-Fei Li.

key_facts.fact: The San Mateo company has now raised more than $650 million in total; it shipped GEN-0 in November 2025 and GEN-1 in April 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: pushing the San Mateo startup's total capital raised past the $650 million mark... The company has been shipping at a rapid clip. It released GEN-0 in November 2025, followed by GEN-1 in April 2026.

key_facts.fact: The funding comes about a week after Generalist unveiled Gen-1.5, a model for robot arms that learns a task from a single human demonstration and completed 10 sample tasks at an average 59% rate after one demo.
key_facts.excerpt: The fundraising news comes about a week after Generalist AI unveiled its new AI model, Gen-1.5. Gen-1.5 is designed for robot arms... tests of Gen-1.5 on 10 sample tasks showed an average completion rate of 59 percent when the task was demonstrated only once.
